title: Extension from the generic point when all local rings are valuation rings
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $X,Y$ be $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base]. Assume that $X$ is integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] and that every local ring $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is a valuation ring, meaning that for each nonzero element $z$ of its fraction field, either $z$ or $z^{-1}$ belongs to $\mathcal O_{X,x}$. Let $K=k(X)=\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ be its function field [def-sc-function-field], with generic-point morphism $i_X:\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume that $Y$ is proper over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Every $k$-morphism $h:\operatorname{Spec}K\to Y$ extends to a $k$-morphism $F:X\to Y$ satisfying $F\circ i_X=h$.
